semantics.schedule_rule: AIGMos `#CAL` schedule is a runtime scheduling definition.
semantics.external_rule: External calendar event/resource has its own provider/domain identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Synchronization/import uses explicit mappings between external calendar identity and AIGMos schedule/resource identity.
semantics.import_rule: Imported calendar content is inert until validated and explicitly accepted into a schedule/resource boundary.
semantics.export_rule: Exporting an AIGMos schedule does not transfer execution authority to an external calendar.
semantics.update_rule: External event edits do not silently rewrite AIGMos schedules unless an explicit authorized sync policy applies.
semantics.ownership_rule: Calendar provider does not become owner of AIGMos schedule semantics by synchronization.
semantics.authority_rule: Meeting/event attendance metadata grants no AIGMos runtime authority.

invariants.rule: A schedule determines when a scheduling occurrence may be emitted; it never directly executes a Routine, command or operation. Execution requires the normal explicit Event→Trigger→Runner/operation causality chain.
